teaser.en: 'The forest banana': a rare, sweet-scented coastal tree whose fruits look like little bunches of bananas.
teaser.sw: 'Ndizi ya msituni': mti adimu wa pwani wenye harufu tamu, ambao matunda yake yanafanana na vichane vidogo vya ndizi.

summary.en: Muizu wa tsakani is Ophrypetalum odoratum, a small, rare tree of coastal forest. Its Digo name means 'banana of the forest' because its fruits look like bananas.
summary.sw: Muizu wa tsakani ni Ophrypetalum odoratum, mti mdogo adimu wa misitu ya pwani. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'ndizi ya msituni' kwa sababu matunda yake yanafanana na ndizi.

about.en: Muizu wa tsakani is a shrub or small tree, about 4 to 5 m tall, of the custard-apple family. Its flowers are strongly perfumed, which gives the species its scientific name, odoratum. Its fruits are clusters of elongated segments that resemble small bananas. The Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: Muizu wa tsakani ni kichaka au mti mdogo, wenye kimo cha takriban mita 4 hadi 5, wa familia ya mitopetope (custard apple). Maua yake yana harufu kali ya manukato, ndiyo inayoipa spishi hii jina lake la kisayansi, odoratum. Matunda yake ni vishada vya vipande virefu vinavyofanana na ndizi ndogo. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.

where.en: It grows only in the coastal forests of south-east Kenya and eastern Tanzania, and has been collected in Kwale and Kilifi districts, south and north of Mombasa.
where.sw: Huota tu katika misitu ya pwani ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na mashariki mwa Tanzania, na umekusanywa katika wilaya za Kwale na Kilifi, kusini na kaskazini mwa Mombasa.

culture.en: Pakia uses this name to explain the affixes tsaka and tsakani, both meaning 'of the forest'; the only difference is that tsakani is joined with the linking word wa.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia jina hili kueleza viambishi tsaka na tsakani, vyote vikiwa na maana ya 'wa msituni'; tofauti pekee ni kwamba tsakani huunganishwa na neno-kiunganishi wa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Muizu wa tsakani, 'banana in the forest', because its fruits resemble mazu, bananas, but it is recognised as a forest kind. No shared names are recorded. Its scientific name is Ophrypetalum odoratum.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Muizu wa tsakani, 'ndizi msituni', kwa sababu matunda yake yanafanana na mazu, ndizi, lakini unatambuliwa kama aina ya msituni. Hakuna majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine yaliyorekodiwa. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Ophrypetalum odoratum.

conservation.en: Ophrypetalum odoratum is listed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List. Its whole range is a narrow strip of coastal forest that is being cleared for farms and building.
conservation.sw: Ophrypetalum odoratum imeorodheshwa kama Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Eneo lake lote la kuenea ni ukanda mwembamba wa misitu ya pwani unaofyekwa kwa ajili ya mashamba na ujenzi.

reason.en: The banana it is named after
Another coastal forest tree of the custard-apple family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa misitu ya pwani wa familia ya mitopetope (custard apple)
Monodora, wa familia ya mitopetope (custard apple)
